The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Bhopal has released an official notification for the recruitment of Junior Residents (Non-Academic) on a contractual basis. Eligible medical graduates can directly attend the walk-in interview scheduled for November 19, 2026.

Notification and Vacancy Overview

  • Issuing Authority: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Bhopal
  • Notification ID / Advt. No.: AIIMS, Bhopal/JR (Non-Acad.)/2026/10
  • Post Name: Junior Resident (Non-Academic)
  • Total Vacancies: 20 Posts
  • Category-wise Breakdown: UR: 09, OBC: 04, EWS: 03, SC: 02, ST: 02 (Includes 01 horizontal reservation for PwBD candidates)

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limit

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) or an Institute of National Importance. The mandatory rotating internship must have been completed within 5 years of the interview date. Candidates must also hold a valid registration with the NMC or State Medical Council.
  • Age Limit: The upper age limit is 33 years as of November 19, 2026. Age relaxations apply to reserved categories (SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD) as per central government norms.

Salary and Contract Terms

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 56,100/- (Level-10, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus admissible allowances including Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA).
  • Appointment Type: Purely contractual and need-based for an initial period of 6 months, extendable for another term based on performance and institutional requirements.

Application Fee and Process

  • Application Fee: Rs. 1000/- for General, OBC, and EWS candidates, payable via Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of "EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, AIIMS, Bhopal". SC, ST, Female, and PwBD candidates are exempt from the fee.
  • Application Mode: Offline via walk-in. There is no online application link. Candidates must bring the prescribed application form available on the official website along with original documents and self-attested photocopies.

Walk-in Interview Schedule and Venue

  • Date: November 19, 2026
  • Reporting Time: 09:00 AM (Entry closes by strict timelines)
  • Interview Start Time: 10:30 AM
  • Venue: 4th Floor, Deanery, Kautilya Bhawan, AIIMS Bhopal, Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020, Madhya Pradesh

Selection Stages

  • Selection will be based on a written test (conducted if applicants exceed 20 per post to shortlist top candidates for interviews) and/or a personal interview. Final ranking depends on interview performance.

How to Verify

Applicants must verify all details, download the official application format, and check for any potential updates directly on the official AIIMS Bhopal website at www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in.
